units.source_text: 父亲不像去年冬天我回家时那么喜欢下将棋了，棋盘一直放在壁龛的角落里，上面落满了灰尘。

en.t: Father no longer liked playing shogi as much as he had when I came home the previous winter, and the shogi board had been left in a corner of the alcove, covered with dust.

units.source_text: 尤其是天皇陛下染病以来，父亲好像总是在沉思，

en.t: Especially after His Majesty the Emperor fell ill, Father always seemed lost in thought,

units.source_text: 每天都焦急地盼着报纸来，自己最先看，

en.t: and every day he anxiously waited for the newspaper to arrive and read it before anyone else,

units.source_text: 然后特意拿着报纸来我的房间，把自己看过的重要消息告诉我。

en.t: then deliberately brought the paper to my room and told me the important news he had read.

units.source_text: “你看看，今天也详细地报道了天子的病情啊。”

en.t: Look, today there is another detailed report on the Son of Heaven's condition.

units.source_text: 父亲常常把天皇陛下称为天子。

en.t: Father often referred to His Majesty the Emperor as the Son of Heaven.

units.source_text: “说句大逆不道的话，天子的病和你爸的病很相似吧。”

en.t: This may be a terribly disloyal thing to say, but the Son of Heaven's illness is quite like your father's, isn't it?

units.source_text: 父亲这样说时，脸上笼罩着一层忧郁的阴云。

en.t: When Father said this, a gloomy shadow settled over his face.

units.source_text: 我听了这话，心里也闪过了一阵不安，说不定什么时候，父亲也会死的。

en.t: Hearing those words, I too felt a flash of uneasiness, thinking that Father might die at any time.
But the Son of Heaven will be all right, I suppose.

units.source_text: 像我这种没用的人，都这么凑合活着哪。”

en.t: Even a useless man like me is still managing to live on like this.

units.source_text: 父亲虽然给自己的健康打了包票，可同时又仿佛预感到即将降临到自己身上的危险。

en.t: Although Father vouched for his own health, at the same time he seemed to sense the danger that was about to befall him.

units.source_text: “你爸我是真的害怕自己的病好不了啦！

en.t: Your father is truly afraid that his illness may never get better!

units.source_text: 我可不是像你妈说的那样，还想活上十年二十年的！”

en.t: I am not thinking of living another ten or twenty years, the way your mother says I am!

units.source_text: 母亲听了我的传话，不知怎么办才好了。

en.t: When Mother heard what I reported to her, she did not know what to do.
Play shogi with him again, will you?

units.source_text: 我从壁龛中取出棋盘，拭去上面的尘土。

en.t: I took the shogi board from the alcove and wiped the dust from it.
